rider.official_documented_capabilities: Rider 2025.3 CLI supports attach-to-process native PID, using LLDB; solution is optional for external processes without source. Disassembly opens for an attached process without debug information; instruction stepping, address breakpoints and register-based address expressions are documented.
rider.important_limit: Native Executable run configuration explicitly does not debug non-.NET code. Native attach support is not proof of direct debugger-controlled startup of an arbitrary native EXE, first-instruction capture or full register-panel support.

steamless_startup.hash_scope: Existing static-analysis identity, not a newly measured hash in this assessment.
steamless_startup.imports: Engine ordinary imports include steam_api64.dll SteamInternal_SteamAPI_Init, callbacks and shutdown. No ordinary import named SteamAPI_Init or SteamAPI_RestartAppIfNecessary was recorded; dynamic/transitive paths remain unknown.
steamless_startup.conclusion: Current Steam build running without any Steam client is UNVERIFIED, not established impossible. Crate officially supports offline single-player, giving Steam offline mode as an example. Valve offline mode still runs games through Steam. Crate describes GOG as a separate DRM-free distribution, not a capability or license supplied by the current Steam files.
steamless_startup.limits: No launch experiment, replacement Steam API, appid fabrication, DRM change, copied-game startup claim or login bypass. No BIOS/virtualization requirement established.

cloud_protection.steam_per_game_official: With permission to open Steam: Library > Grim Dawn > Properties > General > disable Cloud synchronization. This can precede game startup, but requires client startup. Use the per-game setting to avoid changing other games.
cloud_protection.steam_startup_gap: Opening the client before the toggle is verified may process pending synchronization. Existing backup and historical successful upload log do not prove current remote state or eliminate this gap.
cloud_protection.offline_official: Steam offline mode defers synchronization until online again; it does not freeze remote data permanently. Cached login/offline readiness for this machine is unknown. Do not invent a command-line offline switch or force initial online synchronization.
cloud_protection.game_setting: Game Cloud Saving is a separate option. Earlier authorized evidence recorded cloudSaving=true; it was not reread here. Crate developer guidance discusses the in-game toggle and backing up before changing it. No verified official pre-first-start options.txt editing procedure was established.
cloud_protection.game_setting_limit: An in-game toggle necessarily occurs after some game startup. Switching it can change the active save location; no automatic character copying/migration is proposed. It is not proof that startup did not touch original data.
cloud_protection.restore_limit: Do not overwrite originals or edit/delete remotecache.vdf to force Cloud rollback. Restoring local files or later reenabling Cloud needs a separate reviewed plan and explicit consent. Backups do not undo achievements, server state or writes outside the backed-up paths.

proposed_sequence_not_executed.status: Not run; current remote state unknown.

proposed_sequence_not_executed.action: Only after protections and debugger readiness are demonstrated, seek consent for bounded original-game startup/attachment and one menu/scene mouse observation, including the possible local Settings/save writes caused by normal startup. If changing in-game Cloud Saving or creating a disposable test character, approve those explicitly first.
proposed_sequence_not_executed.scope: Maximum 10 minutes / 16 relevant breakpoint hits as the prior proposed bound; current-process identity and ASLR module base must be verified. Observe only the confirmed UI publication / mouse chain and tightly scoped parameters. No memory patching of behavior, forced returns, broad dumps, data migration or original-file change.
proposed_sequence_not_executed.limit: Debugger address breakpoints may instrument process memory and pause/change timing; this is not a zero-effect observation. An attach-only route may miss Game SetUI / other initial registration. Solve that timing requirement before claiming those writers captured.

proposed_sequence_not_executed.action: After an authorized observation, exit normally, confirm owned debug session and target state, preserve a separate post-run evidence snapshot if authorized, compare with baseline, then separately agree any restoration and Cloud reenable/reconnect sequence.
proposed_sequence_not_executed.stop: No automatic original restore, Cloud reenabling or conflict resolution.
